in_marathi.name: Supreetha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Supreetha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Supreetha means 'Graceful, Beautiful'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'supra' meaning 'above' and 'rith' meaning 'to be', indicating one who is above all and possesses beauty.
